visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Replace the else-if Chain with a Helper
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Five almost identical branches count the same thing. Write an is_vowel helper (strchr with "aeiou" does the lookup) and use it in the loop. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The set of vowels now lives in one string, so adding or removing a letter is a one-place change. The c != '\0' test matters because strchr also "finds" the terminator.
